thread:
michelle: Quick design review — final pass on the Playground chat UI. Areas: streaming display behavior, stop / regenerate affordance, token counter placement/semantics, and prompt library access. Can people skim and add bite-sized notes?

samir: skimmed — nice summary. My top question: do we present streamed tokens as a single growing message or append many short messages?

aldo: implementation-wise single growing node is much cheaper (less DOM churn). multiple small messages causes layout thrash and higher memory.

samir: agreed, but UX-wise some folks like seeing line-by-line "progress". Maybe show punctuation flushes?

jia: accessibility note: regardless of representation, streamed content must be in an aria-live region so screen readers get interim updates, but we should throttle updates to avoid verboseness. aria-live="polite" with batching is usually best.

noah: research: users interpret streaming as "still working" — the stop button needs to be very discoverable. People often miss a tiny inline control.

michelle: proposal: while model is generating show a prominent inline control: [Stop] next to the composer, then when generation completes replace with [Regenerate]. Keep control keyboard accessible (Esc to stop, Ctrl/Cmd+R to regen?).

aldo: Esc for stop makes sense. Ctrl+R conflicts with browser reload; maybe Ctrl+Shift+R? or use Alt+R. Also regenerate should be disabled until generation completes, and we should debounce accidental double-clicks.

samir: design idea: a small floating pill near the right edge of the response area: it shows live state ("Streaming..."), an X icon to stop, and after finish becomes a circular regenerate icon + label. Works on mobile too if we keep it touch-sized.

jia: keyboard focus order: when generation starts keep focus in the composer. If user tabs to the control, it must be accessible via keyboard and have aria-pressed or role=button. Also ensure the visual focus ring is high contrast.

samir: mock link: https://figma.com/s/streaming-pill (placeholder)

aldo: another technical nit: streaming updates should not auto-scroll if user has intentionally scrolled up to review earlier tokens. Add a "Follow output" sticky toggle (default on).

michelle: good. Add small default behavior copy: "Following latest output — click to pause autoscroll".

noah: token counter: users want clarity on billing. Options: show "prompt | response | total" counts, or show just total to reduce clutter. We tested both: enterprise customers like breakdowns.

samir: visually small + muted bottom-right of the response card. Click to expand details (tooltip or popover) that shows breakdown + link to billing docs. Also add a tiny ? tooltip explaining what counts.

jia: accessibility for counter: it must be readable by screen readers and not announce constantly while streaming. Announce only when user focuses the counter or on generation end. Use aria-live="polite" only for end-state change.

aldo: real-time updating token counts can be costly to compute per-token. Suggest update every ~250-500ms or only on chunk flush.

michelle: copy tweaks: replace "Tokens used" with "Token usage" and the tooltip: "Tokens billed = prompt + response. See billing docs for pricing."

samir: prompt library entrypoint: two choices — inline dropdown in composer (fast access) or a left rail / modal. I prefer inline because it reduces context-switch.

noah: inline is faster but discoverability suffers if users don't notice the small button. Could do inline primary button "Insert prompt" and also have a keyboard shortcut (/) to open library.

jia: ensure prompt library is keyboard navigable with arrow keys and has proper list semantics (role=list, role=listitem). Also support skip links: "Skip to prompt library" for screen reader users.

aldo: dev details for inserting template: we should insert tokens as plain text with metadata so we can compute prompt tokens precisely (and allow the user to edit after insertion).

samir: mock behavior: when user hovers a prompt in library we show a small preview right of the list with sample conversation and predicted token cost. Clicking inserts into composer.

michelle: UX tradeoff: previews add network calls for token estimates. Maybe show cached estimates or calculate client-side heuristics first, then refine when modal opens.

noah: also want "favorites" and simple search (fuzzy). Keep tags and last-used sorting.

jia: accessibility: previews must be non-essential (aria-hidden) or properly labelled, so screen readers don't get spammed while navigating list.

samir: small copy note: use "Insert" not "Use". "Insert prompt" reads better in context.

aldo: other edge: if user regenerates while offline or capacity-limited, we need graceful error toast and fallback to previous output. Add an indicator for fallback state.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging tomorrow 10:00 PDT (FYI) :rocket:

michelle: Action items: 1) Samir: update mockups for floating streaming pill + token counter placement (due EOD Thurs). 2) Aldo: prototype autoscroll toggle + throttle streaming renders (PR target Fri). 3) Jia: accessibility checklist and aria snippets (send by Wed). 4) Noah: prompt library search/favorites spec (Fri). I'll sync after mocks land and we can do a short UX review. Thanks all :heart:

samir: ack

aldo: ack

jia: ack
